name: Pittsburgh Open 2018
information: The 10th anniversary of the first competition in Pittsburgh (CMU Fall 2008), and the first competition in the immediate area since 2014! Day 1: Main Events (3x3x3, 2x2x2, 4x4x4, 5x5x5, 3x3x3 One-Handed, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, Skewb) Day 2: Side Events (6x6x6, 7x7x7, Clock, Megaminx, 4x4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5x5 Blindfolded)
